newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to softer and quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to softer and quiet.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to a touch softer on Thursday.
Naphtha was steady to slightly softer with crude. Traders said end-user demand remained muted a
Gasoline was steady to firmer bolstered against weaker crude and thin European buying by a trickle of demand from the U.S..
Gas oil firmed 75 cents on futures and premiums were steady. Prompt heating oil barges were Jan IPE -$1.50/-$0.50.
Fuel oil held steady amid very thin activity.
